column5: An organ historian investigating a remote Norfolk parish church uncovers a cursed instrument containing ancient pipes and becomes haunted by terrifying recurring nightmares of a legendary subterranean beast. After ignoring warnings not to inspect the organ, he discovers a dark history of fatal accidents and a deathbed prohibition linked to ancient local folklore.
A monstrous sea serpent terrorized the residents of Coombe Hill until a brave local man named Tom Smith won its trust and slew it. In gratitude, the village rewarded him with limitless free beer.
The San people tell of a giant serpent that lives in a cave on the West side of the hills.
